method: One sequential baseline then selected run on the same otherwise idle Linux host. After fonts and intro: 40 pointer moves, 24 downward then 24 upward native wheel events. rAF intervals and PerformanceObserver longtasks. No CPU throttle. Short samples, first exposure lazy media/sections included; viewport emulation is not mobile hardware; this does not establish sustained 60FPS or a definitive comparative win.
